source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 4: tree, P and Q 30 m apart, angles of elevation 12 and 15 degrees; height of the tree. Answer key PDF 309.

blocks.prompt: 4 \(P\) and \(Q\) are two points in line with a tree. If the distance between \(P\) and \(Q\) be 30 m and the angles of elevation of the top of the tree at \(P\) and \(Q\) be \(12^{\circ}\) and \(15^{\circ}\) respectively, find the height of the tree.
blocks.explanation:
Two observation points, two angles of elevation, unknown height and unknown distance.
We need the height \(h\).
Plan: write \(x\) in two ways using \(\cot\), subtract to remove \(x\), solve for \(h\).
steps:
Given: \(PQ = 30\) m; elevation of the top T is \(12^{\circ}\) at P and \(15^{\circ}\) at Q.
To find: the height \(h = BT\).
Method: Let \(BQ = x\). In each right triangle \(\text{base} = h\cot(\text{angle})\). Two equations, two unknowns; subtracting removes \(x\).

Decide which point is nearer
Why: The bigger angle (\(15^{\circ}\)) is seen from the nearer point, so Q is nearer and \(BP = x + 30\).

Equation from Q
\[\tan 15^{\circ} = \dfrac{h}{x}\]
\[x = h\cot 15^{\circ} \quad (1)\]
Why: Right triangle BQT: opposite \(h\), adjacent \(x\).

Equation from P
\[\tan 12^{\circ} = \dfrac{h}{x + 30}\]
\[x + 30 = h\cot 12^{\circ} \quad (2)\]
Why: Right triangle BPT: adjacent side is \(x + 30\).

Subtract (1) from (2)
\[30 = h(\cot 12^{\circ} - \cot 15^{\circ})\]
\[h = \dfrac{30}{\cot 12^{\circ} - \cot 15^{\circ}}\]
Why: Subtracting removes \(x\), leaving one equation in \(h\).

Put in the values
\[h = \dfrac{30}{4.7046 - 3.7321}\]
\[= \dfrac{30}{0.9725} \approx 30.85 \text{ m}\]
Why: \(\cot 12^{\circ} = 1/\tan 12^{\circ} \approx 4.7046\), \(\cot 15^{\circ} \approx 3.7321\).

Check
\[x = 30.85 \times 3.7321 \approx 115.12\]
\[\tan 12^{\circ} \times 145.12 \approx 30.85 \;\checkmark\]
Why: Using equation (1) for \(x\), the height from P's triangle comes out the same.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The answer key prints height \(= 30.92\) m. The exact value is \(\frac{30}{\cot 12^{\circ} - \cot 15^{\circ}} = 30.85\) m; four-figure tables give about 30.90 m. The key's 30.92 m comes from over-rounded table values; the correct height is 30.85 m.
